review.notes: TRIAGE review of a 148-page document. (a) Full structural scan: the OCR markdown contains no code fences, so no swallowed-block risk; every unnumbered heading was checked against the PDF text layer - the 26 whose text is absent from the text layer are figure-artwork transcriptions and were demoted to bold text or deleted (delete only where the embed was visually confirmed to contain the title); numbered headings, the printed "Metrics" run-in headings on pp.63-76 and real-text headings were kept. (b) Full-document droppage scan: normalized 4-gram containment of every PDF page against the OCR markdown flagged only physical p.109 (Table 8.1.A, whose cells were then verified value-by-value against the markdown HTML table - all scores match; the low rate is cell interleaving) and four blank pages that contain only a printed page number (62, 70, 75, 90). (c) Pages 2, 17, 61, 65, 84, 85, 86, 95, 119 and 120 were rendered and visually inspected; the demotion pattern was visually confirmed on pp.61, 65, 85, 95 and 119 and the deletion pattern on pp.86, 119 and 120. Singleton demotions on other pages rely on the text-layer absence plus the visually confirmed pattern, and their pdf_pages are section-anchor pages read from the text layer. Line-by-line proofreading of unflagged pages was not done.
